Reduce adduct hypotheses to one per feature

Source: R/adducts.R
bestHypotheses.Rd

bestHypotheses() reproduces CAMERA's final choice: within each group it accepts hypotheses from the best ranked down, skipping any hypothesis that contains a feature already explained by an accepted one. Each feature then keeps at most one neutral mass.

Usage

bestHypotheses(x)

Arguments

x

data.frame of hypotheses as returned by annotateAdducts() or adductHints().

Value

The accepted rows of x.

Examples

mz <- c(124.0392, 152.0342, 170.0445, 192.0275, 377.0300)
hints <- annotateAdducts(mz, AdductVoteParam(),
                         intensity = c(81, 50, 100, 11, 2),
                         groups = rep("FG.1", 5))
bestHypotheses(hints)
#>   feature feature_group hypothesis rank        M       adduct n_ions score
#> 1       1          FG.1          1    1 169.0372 [M+H-HCOOH]+      5  4.25
#> 2       2          FG.1          1    1 169.0372   [M+H-H2O]+      5  4.25
#> 3       3          FG.1          1    1 169.0372       [M+H]+      5  4.25
#> 4       4          FG.1          1    1 169.0372      [M+Na]+      5  4.25
#> 5       5          FG.1          1    1 169.0372      [2M+K]+      5  4.25
#>   intensity
#> 1       244
#> 2       244
#> 3       244
#> 4       244
#> 5       244
